interpretation: One starting actor/fine-tuning seed and two maps: exploratory, not universal or statistically significant. Conditioned is compared with equal-budget masked training; v13 and the original hybrid are baselines. The contrast changes actor AND critic command-plus-feedback access, not actor-only or goal-only causality. Action sensitivity does not establish arbitrary command tracking. 16s primary and 64s secondary remain separate; secondary cannot override primary failure. Posture means are conditional on visited valid states, not matched-state causal effects. Ideal ray depth and a kinematic swing proxy do not establish real-camera or robot safety.
